description: The only reconnaissance Cheetah ever built, an Atlas Flight Test aircraft. Listed as displayed at the entrance to the Denel campus on Atlas Road, Kempton Park, and added to the Unofficial SAAF Website list between a 31 December 2025 archived snapshot and the live September 2026 page, which is a strong currency signal. The only dated photograph found is from 11 August 1991, when it was displayed at what was then Jan Smuts International Airport, so the Denel campus placement rests on that list alone.
